Score each onboarding change. Sub-scores:
- impact 0-3: how many users the targeted step loses and how much this could recover
- evidence 0-3: whether the funnel and the support mail both point at this problem
- confidence 0-2: how likely this kind of change works, judged from the lessons below
- cost 0-2: 2 = config only, 0 = needs new screens and a release
Also give predicted_lift: expected relative change in the target step's conversion, e.g. 0.05.

Changes:
0: [sign_in, reorder] Defer Sign-In After Pet Selection: Move the account sign-in screen to occur after pet selection and adoption setup. (why: Sign-in conversion is 72.9% early on; allowing users to choose their pet first builds emotional investment before asking for credentials.)
1: [adoption, redesign] Interactive Pet Customization Stage: Redesign pick_friend with a stage layout featuring live preview animations and playable voice samples. (why: Adoption conversion is low (60.9%) with high median completion time (89s); interactive previews speed up decisions.)
2: [home, wait_info] Pet Generation Waiting Screen Tips & Timer: Show an estimated generation timer and rotating pet feature tips on the waiting screen. (why: The waiting step has an extreme mean duration of 2336s, causing users to think the app stalled.)
3: [sign_in, hint] Account Recovery Guidance on Sign-In: Add clear sign-in hints explaining that signing into existing accounts preserves existing pets. (why: 8 support emails complained about missing or reset pets after signing back in.)
4: [adoption, layout] Photo Upload Guidelines and Sample Preview: Add clear photo requirements and a comparison preview on the photo upload screen. (why: Support messages noted custom pet creation failures and distorted visual results.)
5: [home, notification] Desktop Ready System Notification: Enable desktop notification prompts when waiting for pet generation so users can safely minimize. (why: Users wait over 200s median in home generation step; desktop alerts stop users from quitting while waiting.)

scores.note: Deferring sign-in builds emotional investment before asking for credentials.
Adoption has the highest drop-off (39.1%); interactive features help speed decisions.
Addresses extreme mean wait duration (2336s) by setting clear expectations.
Directly targets 8 support complaints with low-cost copy guidance.
Solves photo upload failures noted in support logs on a major drop-off step.
Desktop alerts prevent drop-offs during long background pet generation.
